measurement_note: Random and K-Means times are deterministic same-parameter replays because the accepted primary artifacts did not persist timings. High-M K-Means replays may differ at a tiny fraction of assignments because of floating-point reduction order; exact disagreement rates are retained and replay artifacts are not used for E1-E4 results.
